provenance: Hand-authored replay fixture (not recorded model output). Facts checked on 2026-10-19 against Shimano DM-RACBR01-03-ENG (2019-04-08), Shimano compatibility charts C-201/C-202/C-456 (Ver 2.7, Oct. 7, 2026), koolstop.com and swissstop.com. Pack size of R55C4 inserts is not confirmed by Shimano.
description: BR-R7000 rim calipers on aluminum rims: R55C4 cartridge inserts (Shimano standard), Kool-Stop Dura 2 and SwissStop FlashPro Original Black as cited alternatives.

output.summary: BR-R7000 on aluminum rims takes R55C4 cartridge inserts.

requirements.title: Brake pad inserts
requirements.reason: Shimano's standard insert for BR-R7000 on aluminum rims.

fit_checks.detail: Chart C-201 lists R55C4 as the standard shoe for BR-R7000
Aluminum rim 20.8-24 mm wide uses R55C4
Inserts are left/right specific; fixing bolt 1-1.5 N·m; reset toe-in after fitting

alternatives.reason: Kool-Stop states fit for Shimano 55 mm holders with set screw.
alternatives.dependency: Uses the existing Shimano cartridge holders.

alternatives.reason: SwissStop lists fit for Shimano Road, aluminum rims.

inferred: Carbon rims would need R55C4 for carbon rims or R55C4-A instead; this answer assumes the confirmed aluminum rims.
Replace when the grooves are worn away (Shimano tech tip). The note's 'look worn' is the mechanic's observation, not a diagnosis.
